target: Observed quarterly real GDP level, constant 2010 prices, billion VND

models.name: SeasonalNaive
models.description: Lặp lại mức của cùng quý năm trước.

models.name: SeasonalDrift
models.description: Seasonal naive cộng mức tăng log cùng quý bình quân 5 năm gần nhất.

models.name: LogTrendQuarterDummies
models.description: OLS log GDP theo xu hướng tuyến tính và biến giả quý; fit lại từng origin.

models.name: ETS_DampedAdditive
models.description: ETS trên log GDP; xu hướng cộng có giảm tốc, mùa vụ cộng chu kỳ 4 quý.

evaluation: Expanding-window rolling-origin; each model is refit at each origin; no random split; all transformations use only each fold's training history.
caveats: Quarterly level series is available at constant 2010 prices through 2025-Q4. The newer 2020-price series is kept separate.
The sample is larger than the annual series but the origins overlap, so forecast errors are dependent.
This quarterly branch supplements but does not replace the annual GDP USD 2015 forecast to 2030.
Seasonal naive and ETS are exploratory forecasting baselines; model selection must use the displayed out-of-sample metrics.
